long_description: Eldeco Ballads of Bliss is an upcoming flagship luxury residential high-rise project located in the high-growth corridor of Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway. Spanning a prime 5-acre corner plot, the development comprises only 3 exclusive high-rise towers rising G+32 floors, housing a total of 580 corner-layout units. Structure-designed on a two-side open plot with 120-meter expressway road frontage, every home features spacious 3 BHK and duplex layouts with three open sides for spectacular natural light and cross ventilation. Each apartment is pre-equipped with advanced centralized VRF air conditioning, expansive private balconies connected to every bedroom, and premium wood framing. The central community layout features an elevated luxury clubhouse, adult and kids swimming pools, a jogging path, and 3-tier gated security, positioned just minutes away from the upcoming Noida International Airport.
